task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick up the blue bowl with slightly rounded base, place it down, then position the blue bowl on top.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，拿起底座略圆的蓝色碗，将其放下，然后将蓝色碗放在上面。
